messages:
Priya Sharma: Quick handoff — PrimeCare (VIP) go‑live next Thu 10:00 PT. I'm covering until 09:30 PT then Ethan will take over. Key things: planned load test at 11:00 PT (internal), customer will ramp to ~400 RPS for 20m max, SLA: 99.9% p50 latency 200ms. Possible risk: new quantized v2 model flagged higher tail latency on long sequences. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/primecare-go-live

Ethan Cole: Ack. What's baseline qps and expected burst pattern?

Priya Sharma: Baseline ~120 RPS steady, 3x spikes on user reports (400) for ~5-10m. Most requests short (avg 80 tokens). We should keep batching at 16 and enable prefix KV cache for patient summaries.

Monica Li: For fallback, prefer model variant or region fallback? My vote: model fallback first to redwood-2-small-quant, then cross-region if necessary.

Priya Sharma: Agreed. Routing policy to use:
```
{
  "priority": ["redwood-2-quant","redwood-2-small-quant","redwood-1-legacy"],
  "max_latency_ms": 1000
}
```
I've left a canary config in Console: /projects/primecare/canary

Diego Ramos: Ops note — cert rotation is scheduled Wed 02:00 PT for the prod load balancer. I moved it to Wed 04:00 PT after talking to infra. Confirmed with infra.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: primecare-api v1.14 canary at 2024-07-11T10:00:00-07:00

Ethan Cole: I'll be on-call from 09:30->16:00 PT Thurs. I'll watch latency dashboards and endpoint error rate. Ping me @Ethan if you see p50 > 250ms.

Priya Sharma: Thanks — small checklist for handoff:
- Confirm canary passes 15m smoke
- Monitor batch size and KV hit rate
- If tail latency >800ms for 3m, switch to small-quant and open a priority ticket

Monica Li: Acked. I'll be available on pager for model-related rollbacks. :thumbsup:

Ethan Cole: Got it. Will set a short pulse in the #incident-broadcast channel at 09:45 PT and again at 10:10 PT.

Priya Sharma: Perfect. Leaving detailed notes in the runbook under 'handoff' section. Good luck team :eyes:
